summary:
SPACEVERSE is an interactive, AI-powered educational space adventure designed for children aged 7–12. It transforms space education into an exciting gaming experience where children can explore planets, complete missions, discover scientific facts and develop their problem-solving skills.

The game takes players through four exciting destinations: Earth, Satellite, Mars and the Moon. Each destination offers unique missions, interactive mini-games and educational challenges.

A friendly AI companion named Astro AI guides children throughout their journey by explaining instructions, answering questions and providing helpful hints. The game also features Mars colony building, rover exploration, satellite communication challenges, rewards and achievements.

SPACEVERSE combines artificial intelligence, gamification and NASA-based educational resources to make learning about space fun, engaging and accessible to young explorers.
details: Detailed Project Description – SPACEVERSE SPACEVERSE is an AI-powered, interactive educational space adventure developed to make space science exciting and accessible for children aged 7–12. The application creates a colourful, cartoon-style space environment where children learn through exploration, missions, challenges and interactive gameplay instead of traditional learning methods. 1. Earth – Astronaut Training Centre Players begin their journey at the Space Academy, where they learn about the solar system, planets, astronaut spacesuits, oxygen systems and basic space safety through fun interactive activities. 2. Satellite – Space Communication Mission Players explore the world of satellites by completing communication challenges, matching satellites with their purposes, learning about GPS and weather satellites, and understanding how signals travel between Earth and spacecraft. 3. Mars – Exploration and Colony Builder Players explore the Martian surface using a rover, discover interesting rocks and investigate possible water resources. They can also build an astronaut colony by constructing habitats, solar panels, oxygen generators, water recyclers, greenhouses and communication systems. Simple resource-management challenges introduce concepts such as oxygen, water, food and electricity. 4. Moon – Lunar Explorer Players explore the lunar surface using a rover, investigate craters, collect scientific samples and learn about lunar rocks, shadows, sunlight and lunar dust. 5. Astro AI – Intelligent Space Companion Astro AI is a friendly robotic astronaut that guides players throughout the adventure. It provides mission instructions, explains difficult concepts in simple language, answers space-related questions and offers contextual hints. Reading assistance, voice interaction and captions make the experience more accessible. 6. Rewards and Progression Players earn stars, points and achievements by completing missions and discovering new information. Game progress is saved locally, allowing children to continue their adventure. 7. NASA Learning Corner The game introduces real scientific information using educational resources from NASA. Children can explore additional space facts through external references. SPACEVERSE combines interactive gaming, artificial intelligence, educational content and creative exploration to encourage curiosity, scientific thinking and problem-solving skills among young learners.
